question: Does the v15/v21-replicated writer frontier causally reconstruct fresh v22 behavior through a frozen native M11 reader, and is its distributed structure redundant or complementary?
evidence_status: Prospective v22 confirmation of two frozen unions plus exhaustive effect-game characterization of a 10-route set selected only from v21. V22 is used neither to choose routes nor to tune a dose. Any subset selected from the v22 game requires a further fresh confirmation.

searched: v15 complete module/head atlases and cross-boundary adaptive greedy result
v20 exact H/R tensor, state, and gain results
v21 exhaustive 24-module/108-head result and its instrument audit
shap_tensor.md and existing exact source-effect games
collision_audit.known_results: L8H1, L9H1, L9H4, and L11H3 are the four strongest v21 behavioral heads and exactly reproduce the independently selected v15 head set. V21 complete MLP1/3/2/4/6/0 each recovers at least 0.335 target behavior. Raw H is not the causal-use geometry; the stable reader must contract it. The old unconditional greedy search had no small selective prefix.
collision_audit.novelty: No test has frozen this cross-corpus component set, evaluated it on untouched rows with exact base-reader-contracted M11 Q, or enumerated its exact 10-route source game.

population: All 16+16 jointly capable A1/A2 v22 rows and all 16 P plus 16 C controls. No row is removed after capability.

frozen_routes.selection_rule: The first six are the v21 non-input complete MLPs with behavior recovery >=0.30, ordered by frozen v21 recovery. The four heads are the complete v15/v21 replicated head set, ordered by v21 recovery.

reader_contracted_endpoint.reader: On the untouched native v22 base forward, replace the MLP11 output by a differentiable leaf and backpropagate the sum of per-row donor-answer-minus-donor-foil margins once. R[row,pos,n]=gradient[row,pos] dot Down[:,n]. R is then frozen for every arm.
reader_contracted_endpoint.writer: For every arm capture MLP11 input x and compute literal H(x)=(x Left^T)*(x Right^T).
reader_contracted_endpoint.task_functional_response: Q_arm[row,n]=sum over valid positions of (H(x_arm)-H(x_base))*R_base. The scalar q_arm is sum over factors. Native q_target uses H(x_donor)-H(x_base) with the same frozen R_base.
reader_contracted_endpoint.status: Q is an exact contraction of the finite MLP11 writer change with a frozen local reader; it is not an exact linearization of later blocks. Exact finite answer-margin behavior is therefore a separate mandatory endpoint.

arms.effect_game: Run every nonempty subset of the 10 routes once over all 64 rows; the native base forward supplies the empty coalition.
arms.closure: Separately run a base self-patch over every upstream site and an all-upstream donor patch. Self must be inert; donor must reconstruct donor final state/margin/M11 input and H. No P/C selectivity condition is applied to complete donor closure.
arms.native: One differentiable base forward and one no-grad donor forward.
arms.no_refit: No subspace, reader, factor, route, rank, dose, coefficient, or greedy order is fitted on v22.

effect_game_math.scalar_games: For target behavior and q separately, v(S) is the signed projection of the A1+A2 arm vector onto its corresponding native target vector. Also compute each construction×direction cell game.
effect_game_math.shapley: phi_i=sum over S not containing i of |S|!(10-|S|-1)!/10! times [v(S union i)-v(S)].
effect_game_math.pair_interaction: I_ij=sum over S excluding i,j of |S|!(10-|S|-2)!/9! times the second difference v(Sij)-v(Si)-v(Sj)+v(S). Positive is complementarity and negative is redundancy for the registered scalar game.
effect_game_math.efficiency: For each scalar game require sum_i phi_i=v(N)-v(empty) to numerical tolerance. This identity validates enumeration; it does not validate causal selectivity.
effect_game_math.frozen_prefix: Report the ten prefixes of ordered_routes. An adaptive greedy and the best subset are discovery summaries only and cannot be promoted on v22.

metrics.target: Behavior and q signed projection, cosine, relative residual, and rowwise direction over pooled A1+A2 and each of four target cells.
metrics.controls: For each component/set intervention, P and C behavior/q RMS movement divided by target native RMS. Raw H norm and factor occupancy are reported only as diagnostics.
metrics.reporter_stability: Repeat scalar-game and Shapley summaries on the two reversed modulo-4 reporter halves without changing any arm.

predictions.pred_a_authority_reader_hooks_closures_e: All hashes, rows, routes, masks, hook calls, and 1,024 coalitions match; base self-patch is <=1e-4 absolute on state/margin/input; donor closure is <=1e-4 on state/margin/input and <=1e-4 relative on H; Shapley efficiency residuals are <=1e-8; all metrics are finite; exactly 1,027 forwards, 65,728 row evaluations, and one transformer backward execute.
predictions.pred_b_frozen_ten_route_union_is_selecti: The full 10-route union has behavior and q signed recovery >=0.60, direction fraction >=0.90, and every P/C behavior/q leak ratio <=0.15.
predictions.pred_c_replicated_four_head_union_is_sel: The frozen four-head union has behavior and q signed recovery >=0.50, direction fraction >=0.90, and every P/C behavior/q leak ratio <=0.15.
predictions.pred_d_effect_is_genuinely_distributed: At least two routes have positive behavior and q Shapley allocations >=0.05, and their allocation signs agree on both reporter halves.
predictions.pred_e_three_of_four_heads_replicate_as_: At least three frozen heads individually have behavior recovery >=0.15, q recovery >=0.05, both directions >=0.75, and every P/C behavior/q leak ratio <=0.10.

opposing_outcomes.reader_contracted_distributed_writer_pro: A-E pass. Preserve the 10-route game, use Shapley/interactions to preregister a smaller subset, and confirm that subset on v23 before weight-tensor promotion.
opposing_outcomes.four_head_writer_program: A/C/E pass but B or D fails. Carry only the fixed four-head union to v23; do not add MLP route sites merely because they have large raw effects.
opposing_outcomes.distributed_nonselective_or_q_mismatch: A passes but B/C fail. Distinguish behavior-only, q-only, and P/C failure; do not tune the v22 subset or reader.
opposing_outcomes.head_singleton_replication_failure: A passes but E fails. The v15/v21 head frontier is not lexically stable enough for promotion.
opposing_outcomes.invalid_instrument: A fails; do not score B-E.
